scripts.build:types: cd backend && python3 -c "import os; from main import app; import json; json.dump(app.openapi(), open('../static/openapi.json','w'), indent=2)" 2>/dev/null || SECRET_KEY=build-32-char-fallback-key python3 -c "import os; os.environ['SECRET_KEY']='build-32-char-fallback-key-'; from main import app; import json; json.dump(app.openapi(), open('../static/openapi.json','w'), indent=2)" && npx openapi-typescript ../static/openapi.json -o ../static/api/schema.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
